# Mediterraneo Solar Energías Renovables - Full Context

## Company Overview
Mediterraneo Solar Energías Renovables is a trusted Home and Construction Business specializing in sustainable energy and climate control. Founded in 2020 by Diego Gonzalez, the company has grown to become a leading provider of solar energy, HVAC, and electrical installations in the Alicante region of Spain.

With a strong focus on quality of work, value for money, good communication, and absolute customer satisfaction, Mediterraneo Solar has maintained a perfect 5/5 rating on Google Reviews. The company has completed over 120+ successful installations.

## Mission
To provide highly efficient, sustainable, and legally compliant energy and climate solutions to residential customers, reducing their carbon footprint and saving them up to 80% on their energy bills.

## Service Details
### Solar Panel Installations
We assess the client's roof and electricity bills to determine the optimal number of panels (typically 6-12). The installation usually takes 1 to 2 days. We handle all the legal paperwork, legalization of the installation, and provide advice on available subsidies.

### HVAC (Air Conditioning and Heating)
We visit the client's home to assess the space and recommend the right system (e.g., a 3.5 kW unit for a standard room, or 5-7 kW for larger areas). Installations are typically completed within a single day.

## Quotes and Maintenance
All quotes are completely free and without obligation. Solar panels are low-maintenance, but we offer annual check-ups and maintenance plans to ensure everything runs perfectly.
